eligibility: US residents cannot open Monzo accounts. Monzo serves the UK (and Ireland) only; its US venture is closed.
biggest_catch: Monzo exited the US — it announced in March/April 2026 (company-confirmed) that it would stop onboarding new US customers, cut ~50 US roles, and close existing US accounts in June 2026. There is no US product left.
catches: Monzo's company spokesperson confirmed the US exit to press in April 2026: 'a deliberate, strategic decision to focus on scaling in our home market and Europe and to step away from the US' (reported by Bloomberg, Retail Banker International, Irish Times).
Existing US accounts closed in June 2026 — before this check — so no US offering remains.
Monzo had already withdrawn its US banking license application in October 2021 after regulators signaled it would not be approved (documented on Monzo's official community site, community.monzo.com).
monzo.com's current sign-up pages offer UK and Ireland accounts only; no US signup path exists.
There is no Monzo signup bonus for US users because there is no US product to sign up for.
